attributes.description: Games the Steam client ran on this machine and the content it downloaded for them, from the gameprocess and content logs. The client logs identify games by Steam application ID only; open [Metrics Steam] Players and playtime for game names.

Processes the Steam client started tracking for a running game. A single launch often starts several, such as a launcher, the game and a crash or bug reporter, so this is not a count of play sessions.

attributes.description: Tracked game processes that exited with a non-zero exit code. On Windows, -1073741819 (0xC0000005) is an access violation, which is how most crashes appear.
